## Activity

During May 2019, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 365 captures. This provides the recorded activity level for the reporting month and supports review of the site’s operational performance. The activity figure should be considered alongside the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable images from the recorded captures. The ungradable rate was 4.9. This result should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality review, with attention given to recurring issues affecting image capture. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and followed up through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

A total of 54 results were recorded as referable. The median grading lag was 5. This provides the reported measure of the time taken for grading during May 2019. The site should continue to review grading activity alongside capture volumes and image quality, ensuring that any recurring operational concerns are documented and raised through the service desk.
